newsitem.title: DENMARK: DANISH SHARES END DOWN AHEAD OF CORPORATE RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: DANISH SHARES END DOWN AHEAD OF CORPORATE RESULTS.

text.p: Danish share prices closed lower on Tuesday in a low activity market failing to follow rises on the British and German bourses, with dealers seeing levels holding or marginally higher on Wednesday morning.
"Tuesday's market followed Monday's quiet trend, playing a waiting game until tomorrow's flurry of key corporate interim 1997 results," one dealer said.

The KFX top-20 index lost 0.54 point to close at 184.55 in overall bourse turnover of 1.035 billion crowns. The KFX August future rose 0.15 point to 184.50 with 2,384 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
On Wednesday Novo Nordisk and SAS deliver their first-half year results, while B&O announces its full year 1996/97 figures.
On the eve of the results, Novo fell three crowns to 704, SAS put on 4.5 crowns to finish at 195, with B&O shed 10 crowns to end the day at 370.
